name: Hungaroring
description: The Hungaroring, in a dusty valley outside Budapest. Tight and twisty with few places to pass, so the grid and the pit stops decide a lot.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (304 of 1752 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
